referenceVideos.title: How to Make AI-Generated UI Look Expensive (7 Fixes) / The 7 Things Every Beautiful UI Has
referenceVideos.author: Griffin Wooldridge
corePillars: 1. Focal Point (One dominant subject, one primary CTA)
3. Typography (Balanced 2-line wraps, zero orphans, 2 families max + tabular-nums)
4. Color (Material-grounded :root tokens, zero AI purple gradients)
5. Real Content (Authentic specs & real product UI, zero fake metrics/testimonials)
6. Details (1px structural hairlines, optical border radii, tactile states)
7. Motion (Purposeful cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) ease-out, never transition: all)
